==Usage==
<nowiki>{{</nowiki>DarkStryder|adventure=ADVENTURE NAME|book=BOOK NAME|reprint=yes (Appearances only, leave blank for reference citation)}}

Place the code on the page and replace the following:
:ADVENTURE NAME = specific RPG module from ''The DarkStryder Campaign''
:BOOK NAME = specific supplement from ''The DarkStryder Campaign''
:REPRINT = only to be used in Appearances section to indicate that the subject also appeared/was mentioned in the collected edition ''The DarkStryder Campaign, Deluxe''. Enter "reprint=yes" to the "reprint" field to add {{C|Reprinted and collected in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign, Deluxe]]''}}. Not to be used in reference citations; leave field blank if used for references.

<nowiki>{{</nowiki>DarkStryder|adventure=Artifact of Aaris|book=The DarkStryder Campaign|reprint=yes}} creates {{DarkStryder|adventure=Artifact of Aaris|book=The DarkStryder Campaign|reprint=yes}}

<nowiki>{{</nowiki>DarkStryder|adventure=Artifact of Aaris|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}} creates {{DarkStryder|adventure=Artifact of Aaris|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}
